content.title: Iron Man 2
content.overview: With the world now aware of his dual life as the armored superhero Iron Man, billionaire inventor Tony Stark faces pressure from the government, the press and the public to share his technology with the military. Unwilling to let go of his invention, Stark, with Pepper Potts and James 'Rhodey' Rhodes at his side, must forge new alliances – and confront powerful enemies.
content.tagline: It's not the armor that makes the hero, but the man inside.

Title: Iron Man 2

Tagline: It's not the armor that makes the hero, but the man inside.

Overview: With the world now aware of his dual life as the armored superhero Iron Man, billionaire inventor Tony Stark faces pressure from the government, the press and the public to share his technology with the military. Unwilling to let go of his invention, Stark, with Pepper Potts and James 'Rhodey' Rhodes at his side, must forge new alliances – and confront powerful enemies.

Genres: Adventure, Action, Science Fiction

Collection: Iron Man Collection

Production Companies: Marvel Studios, Fairview Entertainment, Marvel Entertainment

Production Countries: United States of America

Spoken Languages: English, Russian, French
